options.content: Strategy portfolio from ControllerDiagnostics.state (virtual wallet when ledger_source=virtual, otherwise exchange account). Wealth delta over the selected time window is decomposed without residual into Net Spread Capture, Inventory Drift, and Adverse Selection. Identity: Total Wealth PnL = Net Spread Capture + Inventory Drift + Adverse Selection. Active Alpha = Total Wealth PnL - Hold Strategy PnL. Exchange trading fees are absorbed inside Net Spread Capture via net cash balances.

  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','mid'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['state','mid'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END, 0.0)) AS total_mark_price
  FROM mm_events e

  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
),
scope_rows AS (
  SELECT "time", 'local' AS metric,
         local_cash AS cash,
         local_inventory AS inventory,
         local_mark_price AS mark_price
  FROM state_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time", 'global',
         global_cash,
         global_inventory,
         global_mark_price
  FROM state_rows
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "time", 'total',
         (local_cash + global_cash),
         (local_inventory + global_inventory),
         total_mark_price
  FROM state_rows
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT "time",
         metric,
         cash,
         inventory,
         mark_price,
         LAG(cash) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY "time") AS cash_prev,
         LAG(inventory) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY "time") AS inventory_prev,
         LAG(mark_price) OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY "time") AS mark_price_prev
  FROM scope_rows
),
step_parts AS (
  SELECT "time",
         metric,
         (cash - cash_prev) AS delta_cash,
         (inventory - inventory_prev) AS delta_inventory,
         (mark_price - mark_price_prev) AS delta_price,
         inventory_prev,
         mark_price_prev
  FROM deltas
  WHERE cash_prev IS NOT NULL
    AND inventory_prev IS NOT NULL
    AND mark_price_prev IS NOT NULL
),
component_steps AS (
  SELECT "time", metric,
         (delta_cash + delta_inventory * mark_price_prev) AS net_spread_capture,
         (inventory_prev * delta_price) AS inventory_drift,
         (delta_inventory * delta_price) AS adverse_selection,
         ((delta_cash + delta_inventory * mark_price_prev) + (inventory_prev * delta_price) + (delta_inventory * delta_price)) AS total_wealth_delta
  FROM step_parts
),
inventory_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    (ARRAY_AGG(inventory ORDER BY "time" ASC))[1] AS starting_inventory,
    (ARRAY_AGG(COALESCE(mark_price, 0.0) ORDER BY "time" ASC))[1] AS starting_mark_price,
    (ARRAY_AGG(COALESCE(mark_price, 0.0) ORDER BY "time" DESC))[1] AS ending_mark_price
  FROM scope_rows
  WHERE metric = 'total'
),
pnl_summary AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(total_wealth_delta), 0.0) AS total_pnl,
    COALESCE(SUM(net_spread_capture), 0.0) AS spread_pnl,
    COALESCE(SUM(inventory_drift), 0.0) AS inventory_pnl,
    COALESCE(SUM(adverse_selection), 0.0) AS adverse_selection
  FROM component_steps
  WHERE metric = 'total'
)
SELECT ($__timeTo())::timestamptz AS "time",
       p.total_pnl AS value
FROM pnl_summary p
LEFT JOIN inventory_bounds ib ON TRUE
